the thymic epithelium expressing autoimmune regulator (AIRE) is almost exclusively postmitotic and undergoes rapid turnover.

the mechanisms that regulate the expression of Aire in the thymic medulla.
the proliferation and turnover properties of thymic medulla epithelial cells expressing the autoimmune regulator protein.
the development, proliferation, and turnover of AIRE-expressing medullary thymic epithelia.
